**ID:** Bu-Vb Pc28
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 28
**Title (English, from literature):** Traveling on a boat with a nun
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul0.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Full parallels to this rule are attested across the Prātimokṣa and Vibhaṅga texts of all surviving Vinaya recensions. Within the Pali canon, it corresponds to rule 28 in the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha and the Bhikkhu Parivāra. In other traditions, it appears as Sarvāstivāda Pācittiya 25 (extant in Chinese and Sanskrit), Mūlasarvāstivāda Pācittiya 27 (in Chinese, Tibetan, and Sanskrit manuscripts), Mahīśāsaka Pācittiya 29, Dharmaguptaka Pācittiya 28, and Mahāsāṅghika/Lokottaravāda Pācittiya 27. Modern English translations include that by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
